speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.

speaker: god
text: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.

speaker: god
text: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you.

speaker: god
text: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;

speaker: god
text: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;

speaker: god
text: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;

speaker: god
text: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;

speaker: god
text: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;

speaker: god
text: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;

speaker: god
text: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;

speaker: god
text: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;

speaker: god
text: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;

speaker: god
text: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;

speaker: god
text: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.

speaker: god
text: Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.

speaker: god
text: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.

speaker: god
text: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.

speaker: god
text: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.

speaker: god
text: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.

speaker: god
text: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard:

speaker: god
text: The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab, and his division numbers 74,600.

speaker: god
text: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 54,400.

speaker: god
text: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 57,400.

speaker: god
text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.

speaker: god
text: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard:

speaker: god
text: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur, and his division numbers 46,500.

speaker: god
text: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 59,300.

speaker: god
text: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 45,650.

speaker: god
text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.

speaker: god
text: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.

speaker: god
text: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard:

speaker: god
text: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud, and his division numbers 40,500.

speaker: god
text: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 32,200.

speaker: god
text: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 35,400.

speaker: god
text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.

speaker: god
text: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard:

speaker: god
text: The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, and his division numbers 62,700.

speaker: god
text: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 41,500.

speaker: god
text: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,

speaker: god
text: and his division numbers 53,400.

speaker: god
text: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.

speaker: god
text: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.

speaker: god
text: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.

speaker: god
text: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,

speaker: god
text: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.

speaker: god
text: Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.

speaker: god
text: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.

speaker: god
text: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,

speaker: god
text: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.

speaker: god
text: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,

speaker: god
text: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.

speaker: god
text: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.

speaker: god
text: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.

speaker: god
text: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.

speaker: god
text: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.

speaker: god
text: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.

speaker: god
text: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.

speaker: god
text: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.

speaker: god
text: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.

speaker: god
text: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,

speaker: god
text: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.

speaker: god
text: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.

speaker: god
text: Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.

speaker: god
text: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.

speaker: god
text: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.

speaker: god
text: Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,

speaker: god
text: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:

speaker: god
text: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

speaker: god
text: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.

speaker: god
text: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.

speaker: god
text: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

speaker: god
text: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,

speaker: god
text: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,

speaker: god
text: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.

speaker: god
text: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease, anyone who has a bodily discharge, and anyone who is defiled by a dead body.

speaker: god
text: You must send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.

speaker: god
text: Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty

speaker: god
text: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.

speaker: god
text: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.

speaker: god
text: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.

speaker: god
text: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him

speaker: god
text: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),

speaker: god
text: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself—or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself—

speaker: god
text: then he is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.

speaker: god
text: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD, he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial, which is the grain offering for jealousy. The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse.

speaker: god
text: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.

speaker: unnamed-priest
name: The priest
text: If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.

speaker: god
text: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—

speaker: unnamed-priest
text: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband

speaker: god
text: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse—‘then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.

speaker: unnamed-priest
text: then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.

speaker: god
text: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’

speaker: unnamed-priest
text: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.

speaker: unnamed-woman
name: The woman
text: Amen, Amen.

speaker: god
text: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water.

speaker: god
text: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and cause her bitter suffering.

speaker: god
text: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.

speaker: god
text: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.

speaker: god
text: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.

speaker: god
text: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,

speaker: god
text: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.

speaker: god
text: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

speaker: god
text: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink. He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.

speaker: god
text: All the days of his separation, he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.

speaker: god
text: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall pass over his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.

speaker: god
text: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.

speaker: god
text: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die, he is not to defile himself, because the crown of consecration to his God is upon his head.

speaker: god
text: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: If someone suddenly dies in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing—the seventh day.

speaker: god
text: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him, because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. On that day he must consecrate his head again.

speaker: god
text: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. But the preceding days shall not be counted, because his separation was defiled.

speaker: god
text: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete: He must be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,

speaker: god
text: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering—

speaker: god
text: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.

speaker: god
text: He shall also offer the ram as a peace offering to the LORD, along with the basket of unleavened bread. And the priest is to offer the accompanying grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head, take the hair, and put it on the fire under the peace offering.

speaker: god
text: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.

speaker: god
text: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. This is a holy portion for the priest, in addition to the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.

speaker: god
text: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.

speaker: god
text: Tell Aaron and his sons: This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:

speaker: god
text: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;

speaker: aaron-and-sons
name: Aaron and his sons
text: May the LORD bless you and keep you;

speaker: god
text: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;

speaker: aaron-and-sons
text: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;

speaker: god
text: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’

speaker: aaron-and-sons
text: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.

speaker: god
text: So they shall put My name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.

speaker: god
text: Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.

speaker: god
text: Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.

speaker: god
text: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.

speaker: god
text: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.

speaker: god
text: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.

speaker: god
text: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.

speaker: god
text: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.

speaker: god
text: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.

speaker: god
text: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.

speaker: god
text: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.

speaker: god
text: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.

speaker: god
text: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.

speaker: god
text: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.

speaker: god
text: This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.

speaker: god
text: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.

speaker: god
text: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.

speaker: unnamed-unclean-men
name: Some men who were unclean due to a dead body
text: We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,

speaker: god
text: Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;

speaker: moses
text: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;

speaker: god
text: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.

speaker: moses
text: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.

speaker: god
text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.

speaker: moses
text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.

speaker: god
text: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’

speaker: moses
text: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.

speaker: god
text: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.

speaker: god
text: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.

speaker: god
text: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.

speaker: god
text: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.

speaker: god
text: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.

speaker: god
text: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.

speaker: god
text: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.

speaker: god
text: I will give it to you.

speaker: hobab
name: Hobab
text: I will not go,

speaker: hobab
text: Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.

speaker: moses
text: Please do not leave us,

speaker: moses
text: since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.

speaker: moses
text: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.

speaker: moses
text: Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.

speaker: moses
text: Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: Who will feed us meat?

speaker: israelites
text: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.

speaker: israelites
text: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?

speaker: moses
text: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,

speaker: moses
text: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’

speaker: israelites
text: Give us meat to eat!

speaker: moses
text: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.

speaker: moses
text: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.

speaker: god
text: Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.

speaker: god
text: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.

speaker: god
text: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

speaker: israelites
text: Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!

speaker: god
text: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,

speaker: god
text: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’

speaker: israelites
text: Why did we ever leave Egypt?

speaker: moses
text: Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’

speaker: god
text: I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.

speaker: moses
text: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?

speaker: god
text: Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.

speaker: unnamed-young-man
name: A young man
text: Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.

speaker: joshua
name: Joshua
text: Moses, my lord, stop them!
tag: Joshua son of Nun, the attendant to Moses since youth

speaker: moses
text: Are you jealous on my account? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets and that the LORD would place His Spirit on them!

speaker: miriam-and-aaron
name: Miriam and Aaron
text: Does the LORD speak only through Moses?

speaker: miriam-and-aaron
text: Does He not also speak through us?

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: You three, come out to the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will reveal Myself to him in a vision; I will speak to him in a dream.

speaker: god
text: But this is not so with My servant Moses; he is faithful in all My house.

speaker: god
text: I speak with him face to face, clearly and not in riddles; he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you unafraid to speak against My servant Moses?

speaker: aaron
name: Aaron
text: My lord, please do not hold against us this sin we have so foolishly committed.

speaker: aaron
text: Please do not let her be like a stillborn infant whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: O God, please heal her!

speaker: god
text: If her father had but spit in her face, would she not have been in disgrace for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days; after that she may be brought back in.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Send out for yourself men to spy out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the Israelites. From each of their fathers’ tribes send one man who is a leader among them.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Go up through the Negev and into the hill country.

speaker: moses
text: See what the land is like and whether its people are strong or weak, few or many.

speaker: moses
text: Is the land where they live good or bad? Are the cities where they dwell open camps or fortifications?

speaker: moses
text: Is the soil fertile or unproductive? Are there trees in it or not? Be courageous, and bring back some of the fruit of the land.

speaker: twelve-spies
name: The twelve spies
text: We went into the land to which you sent us, and indeed, it is flowing with milk and honey. Here is some of its fruit!

speaker: twelve-spies
text: Nevertheless, the people living in the land are strong, and the cities are large and fortified. We even saw the descendants of Anak there.

speaker: twelve-spies
text: The Amalekites live in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites live in the hill country; and the Canaanites live by the sea and along the Jordan.

speaker: caleb
name: Caleb
text: We must go up and take possession of the land, for we can certainly conquer it!

speaker: ten-spies
name: The men who had gone up with Caleb
text: We cannot go up against the people, for they are stronger than we are!
tag: the men who had gone up with him

speaker: ten-spies
text: The land we explored devours its inhabitants, and all the people we saw there are great in stature.

speaker: ten-spies
text: We even saw the Nephilim there—the descendants of Anak that come from the Nephilim! We seemed like grasshoppers in our own sight, and we must have seemed the same to them!

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: If only we had died in the land of Egypt, or if only we had died in this wilderness!

speaker: israelites
text: Why is the LORD bringing us into this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and children will become plunder. Would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?

speaker: israelites
text: Let us appoint a leader and return to Egypt.

speaker: joshua-and-caleb
name: Joshua and Caleb
text: The land we passed through and explored is an exceedingly good land.

speaker: joshua-and-caleb
text: If the LORD delights in us, He will bring us into this land, a land flowing with milk and honey, and He will give it to us.

speaker: joshua-and-caleb
text: Only do not rebel against the LORD, and do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they will be like bread for us. Their protection has been removed, and the LORD is with us. Do not be afraid of them!

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: How long will this people treat Me with contempt? How long will they refuse to believe in Me, despite all the signs I have performed among them?

speaker: god
text: I will strike them with a plague and destroy them—and I will make you into a nation greater and mightier than they are.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: The Egyptians will hear of it, for by Your strength You brought this people from among them.

speaker: moses
text: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have already heard that You, O LORD, are in the midst of this people, that You, O LORD, have been seen face to face, that Your cloud stands over them, and that You go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of fire by night.

speaker: moses
text: If You kill this people as one man, the nations who have heard of Your fame will say,

speaker: moses
text: ‘Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.’

speaker: nations
name: The nations
text: Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land He swore to give them, He has slaughtered them in the wilderness.

speaker: moses
text: So now I pray, may the power of my Lord be magnified, just as You have declared:

speaker: moses
text: ‘The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.’

speaker: god
text: The LORD is slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion, forgiving iniquity and transgression. Yet He will by no means leave the guilty unpunished; He will visit the iniquity of the fathers upon their children to the third and fourth generation.

speaker: moses
text: Pardon, I pray, the iniquity of this people, in keeping with the greatness of Your loving devotion, just as You have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.

speaker: god
text: I have pardoned them as you requested,

speaker: god
text: Yet as surely as I live and as surely as the whole earth is filled with the glory of the LORD,

speaker: god
text: not one of the men who have seen My glory and the signs I performed in Egypt and in the wilderness—yet have tested Me and disobeyed Me these ten times—

speaker: god
text: not one will ever see the land that I swore to give their fathers. None of those who have treated Me with contempt will see it.

speaker: god
text: But because My servant Caleb has a different spirit and has followed Me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land he has entered, and his descendants will inherit it.

speaker: god
text: Now since the Amalekites and Canaanites are living in the valleys, turn back tomorrow and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea.

speaker: god
text: How long will this wicked congregation grumble against Me? I have heard the complaints that the Israelites are making against Me.

speaker: god
text: So tell them: As surely as I live, declares the LORD, I will do to you exactly as I heard you say.

speaker: god
text: Your bodies will fall in this wilderness—all who were numbered in the census, everyone twenty years of age or older—because you have grumbled against Me.

speaker: god
text: Surely none of you will enter the land in which I swore to settle you, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.

speaker: god
text: But I will bring your children, whom you said would become plunder, into the land you have rejected—and they will enjoy it.

speaker: god
text: As for you, however, your bodies will fall in this wilderness.

speaker: god
text: Your children will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and they will suffer for your unfaithfulness until the last of your bodies lies in the wilderness.

speaker: god
text: In keeping with the forty days you spied out the land, you shall bear your guilt forty years—a year for each day—and you will experience My alienation.

speaker: god
text: I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will surely do these things to this entire wicked congregation, which has conspired against Me. They will meet their end in the wilderness, and there they will die.

speaker: israelites
text: We have indeed sinned,

speaker: israelites
text: but we will go to the place the LORD has promised.

speaker: moses
text: Why are you transgressing the commandment of the LORD? This will not succeed!

speaker: moses
text: Do not go up, lest you be struck down by your enemies, because the LORD is not among you.

speaker: moses
text: For there the Amalekites and Canaanites will face you, and you will fall by the sword. Because you have turned away from the LORD, He will not be with you.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: After you enter the land that I am giving you as a home

speaker: god
text: and you present an offering made by fire to the LORD from the herd or flock to produce a pleasing aroma to the LORD—either a burnt offering or a sacrifice, for a special vow or freewill offering or appointed feast—

speaker: god
text: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall also present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter hin of olive oil.

speaker: god
text: With the burnt offering or sacrifice of each lamb, you are to prepare a quarter hin of wine as a drink offering.

speaker: god
text: With a ram you are to prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of olive oil,

speaker: god
text: and a third of a hin of wine as a drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,

speaker: god
text: present with the bull a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of olive oil.

speaker: god
text: Also present half a hin of wine as a drink offering. It is an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: This is to be done for each bull, ram, lamb, or goat.

speaker: god
text: This is how you must prepare each one, no matter how many.

speaker: god
text: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: And for the generations to come, if a foreigner residing with you or someone else among you wants to prepare an offering made by fire as a pleasing aroma to the LORD, he is to do exactly as you do.

speaker: god
text: The assembly is to have the same statute both for you and for the foreign resident; it is a permanent statute for the generations to come. You and the foreigner shall be the same before the LORD.

speaker: god
text: The same law and the same ordinance will apply both to you and to the foreigner residing with you.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you enter the land to which I am bringing you

speaker: god
text: and you eat the food of the land, you shall lift up an offering to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: From the first of your dough, you are to lift up a cake as a contribution; offer it just like an offering from the threshing floor.

speaker: god
text: Throughout your generations, you are to give the LORD an offering from the first of your dough.

speaker: god
text: Now if you stray unintentionally and do not obey all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses—

speaker: god
text: all that the LORD has commanded you through Moses from the day the LORD gave them and continuing through the generations to come—

speaker: god
text: and if it was done unintentionally without the knowledge of the congregation, then the whole congregation is to prepare one young bull as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and drink offering according to the regulation, and one male goat as a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to make atonement for the whole congregation of Israel, so that they may be forgiven; for the sin was unintentional and they have brought to the LORD an offering made by fire and a sin offering, presented before the LORD for their unintentional sin.

speaker: god
text: Then the whole congregation of Israel and the foreigners residing among them will be forgiven, since it happened to all the people unintentionally.

speaker: god
text: Also, if one person sins unintentionally, he is to present a year-old female goat as a sin offering.

speaker: god
text: And the priest shall make atonement before the LORD on behalf of the person who erred by sinning unintentionally; and when atonement has been made for him, he will be forgiven.

speaker: god
text: You shall have the same law for the one who acts in error, whether he is a native-born Israelite or a foreigner residing among you.

speaker: god
text: But the person who sins defiantly, whether a native or foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That person shall be cut off from among his people.

speaker: god
text: He shall certainly be cut off, because he has despised the word of the LORD and broken His commandment; his guilt remains on him.

speaker: god
text: The man must surely be put to death. The whole congregation is to stone him outside the camp.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them that throughout the generations to come they are to make for themselves tassels for the corners of their garments, with a blue cord on each tassel.

speaker: god
text: These will serve as tassels for you to look at, so that you may remember all the commandments of the LORD, that you may obey them and not prostitute yourselves by following your own heart and your own eyes.

speaker: god
text: Then you will remember and obey all My commandments, and you will be holy to your God.

speaker: god
text: I am the LORD your God who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the LORD your God.

speaker: korah-and-followers
name: Korah and his followers
text: You have taken too much upon yourselves! For everyone in the entire congregation is holy, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Tomorrow morning the LORD will reveal who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring that person near to Himself. The one He chooses, He will bring near to Himself.

speaker: moses
text: You, Korah, and all your followers are to do as follows: Take censers,

speaker: moses
text: and tomorrow you are to place fire and incense in them in the presence of the LORD. Then the man the LORD chooses will be the one who is holy. It is you sons of Levi who have taken too much upon yourselves!

speaker: moses
text: Now listen, you sons of Levi!

speaker: moses
text: Is it not enough for you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel and brought you near to Himself to perform the work at the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?

speaker: moses
text: He has brought you near, you and all your fellow Levites, but you are seeking the priesthood as well.

speaker: moses
text: Therefore, it is you and all your followers who have conspired against the LORD! As for Aaron, who is he that you should grumble against him?

speaker: dathan-and-abiram
name: Dathan and Abiram
text: We will not come!

speaker: dathan-and-abiram
text: Is it not enough that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey to kill us in the wilderness? Must you also appoint yourself as ruler over us?

speaker: dathan-and-abiram
text: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey or given us an inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you gouge out the eyes of these men? No, we will not come!

speaker: moses
text: Do not regard their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them or mistreated a single one of them.

speaker: moses
text: You and all your followers are to appear before the LORD tomorrow—you and they and Aaron.

speaker: moses
text: Each man is to take his censer, place incense in it, and present it before the LORD—250 censers. You and Aaron are to present your censers as well.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Separate yourselves from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.

speaker: moses-and-aaron
name: Moses and Aaron
text: O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, when one man sins, will You be angry with the whole congregation?

speaker: god
text: Tell the congregation to move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.

speaker: moses
text: Move away now from the tents of these wicked men. Do not touch anything that belongs to them, or you will be swept away because of all their sins.

speaker: moses
text: This is how you will know that the LORD has sent me to do all these things, for it was not my own doing:

speaker: moses
text: If these men die a natural death, or if they suffer the fate of all men, then the LORD has not sent me.

speaker: moses
text: But if the LORD brings about something unprecedented, and the earth opens its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them so that they go down alive into Sheol, then you will know that these men have treated the LORD with contempt.

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: The earth may swallow us too!
tag: all the people of Israel who were around them

speaker: god
text: Tell Eleazar son of Aaron the priest to remove the censers from the flames and to scatter the coals far away, because the censers are holy.

speaker: god
text: As for the censers of those who sinned at the cost of their own lives, hammer them into sheets to overlay the altar, for these were presented before the LORD, and so have become holy. They will serve as a sign to the Israelites.

speaker: israelites
text: You have killed the LORD’s people!

speaker: god
text: Get away from this congregation so that I may consume them in an instant.

speaker: moses
text: Take your censer, place fire from the altar in it, and add incense. Go quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, because wrath has come out from the LORD; the plague has begun.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to the Israelites and take from them twelve staffs, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man’s name on his staff,

speaker: god
text: and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.

speaker: god
text: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.

speaker: god
text: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.

speaker: god
text: Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!

speaker: israelites
text: Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to perish?

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: You and your sons and your father’s house must bear the iniquity involving the sanctuary. And you and your sons alone must bear the iniquity involving your priesthood.

speaker: god
text: But bring with you also your brothers from the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, that they may join you and assist you and your sons before the Tent of the Testimony.

speaker: god
text: And they shall attend to your duties and to all the duties of the Tent; but they must not come near to the furnishings of the sanctuary or the altar, or both they and you will die.

speaker: god
text: They are to join you and attend to the duties of the Tent of Meeting, doing all the work at the Tent; but no outsider may come near you.

speaker: god
text: And you shall attend to the duties of the sanctuary and of the altar, so that wrath may not fall on the Israelites again.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I Myself have selected your fellow Levites from the Israelites as a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD to perform the service for the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: But only you and your sons shall attend to your priesthood for everything concerning the altar and what is inside the veil, and you are to perform that service. I am giving you the work of the priesthood as a gift, but any outsider who comes near the sanctuary must be put to death.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have put you in charge of My offerings. As for all the sacred offerings of the Israelites, I have given them to you and your sons as a portion and a permanent statute.

speaker: god
text: A portion of the most holy offerings reserved from the fire will be yours. From all the offerings they render to Me as most holy offerings, whether grain offerings or sin offerings or guilt offerings, that part belongs to you and your sons.

speaker: god
text: You are to eat it as a most holy offering, and every male may eat it. You shall regard it as holy.

speaker: god
text: And this is yours as well: the offering of their gifts, along with all the wave offerings of the Israelites. I have given this to you and your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat it.

speaker: god
text: I give you all the freshest olive oil and all the finest new wine and grain that the Israelites give to the LORD as their firstfruits.

speaker: god
text: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD will belong to you. Every ceremonially clean person in your household may eat them.

speaker: god
text: Every devoted thing in Israel belongs to you.

speaker: god
text: The firstborn of every womb, whether man or beast, that is offered to the LORD belongs to you. But you must surely redeem every firstborn son and every firstborn male of unclean animals.

speaker: god
text: You are to pay the redemption price for a month-old male according to your valuation: five shekels of silver, according to the sanctuary shekel, which is twenty gerahs.

speaker: god
text: But you must not redeem the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat; they are holy. You are to sprinkle their blood on the altar and burn their fat as an offering made by fire, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: And their meat belongs to you, just as the breast and right thigh of the wave offering belong to you.

speaker: god
text: All the holy offerings that the Israelites present to the LORD I give to you and to your sons and daughters as a permanent statute. It is a permanent covenant of salt before the LORD for you and your offspring.

speaker: god
text: You will have no inheritance in their land, nor will you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: Behold, I have given to the Levites all the tithes in Israel as an inheritance in return for the work they do, the service of the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: No longer may the Israelites come near to the Tent of Meeting, or they will incur guilt and die.

speaker: god
text: The Levites are to perform the work of the Tent of Meeting, and they must bear their iniquity. This is a permanent statute for the generations to come. The Levites will not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: For I have given to the Levites as their inheritance the tithe that the Israelites present to the LORD as a contribution. That is why I told them that they would not receive an inheritance among the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Levites and tell them: ‘When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: When you receive from the Israelites the tithe that I have given you as your inheritance, you must present part of it as an offering to the LORD—a tithe of the tithe.

speaker: god
text: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

speaker: moses
text: Your offering will be reckoned to you as grain from the threshing floor or juice from the winepress.

speaker: god
text: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.

speaker: moses
text: So you are to present an offering to the LORD from all the tithes you receive from the Israelites, and from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest.

speaker: god
text: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’

speaker: moses
text: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.

speaker: god
text: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.

speaker: moses
text: When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.

speaker: god
text: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: moses
text: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’

speaker: moses
text: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke.

speaker: god
text: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will have it brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.

speaker: god
text: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.

speaker: god
text: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight. Its hide, its flesh, and its blood are to be burned, along with its dung.

speaker: god
text: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.

speaker: god
text: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.

speaker: god
text: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.

speaker: god
text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.

speaker: god
text: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent statute for the Israelites and for the foreigner residing among them.

speaker: god
text: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days.

speaker: god
text: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.

speaker: god
text: Anyone who touches a human corpse and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person must be cut off from Israel. He remains unclean, because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him, and his uncleanness is still on him.

speaker: god
text: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days,

speaker: god
text: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.

speaker: god
text: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.

speaker: god
text: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.

speaker: god
text: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.

speaker: god
text: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.

speaker: god
text: But if a person who is unclean does not purify himself, he will be cut off from the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water of purification has not been sprinkled on him; he is unclean.

speaker: god
text: This is a permanent statute for the people: The one who sprinkles the water of purification must wash his clothes, and whoever touches the water of purification will be unclean until evening.

speaker: god
text: Anything the unclean person touches will become unclean, and anyone who touches it will be unclean until evening.

speaker: israelites
name: The Israelites
text: If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!

speaker: israelites
text: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness for us and our livestock to die here?

speaker: israelites
text: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place? It is not a place of grain, figs, vines, or pomegranates—and there is no water to drink!

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take the staff and assemble the congregation. You and your brother Aaron are to speak to the rock while they watch, and it will pour out its water. You will bring out water from the rock and provide drink for the congregation and their livestock.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Listen now, you rebels, must we bring you water out of this rock?

speaker: god
text: Because you did not trust Me to show My holiness in the sight of the Israelites, you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given them.

speaker: israelite-messengers
name: Messengers of Israel
text: This is what your brother Israel says: You know all the hardship that has befallen us,

speaker: israelite-messengers
text: how our fathers went down to Egypt, where we lived many years. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers,

speaker: israelite-messengers
text: and when we cried out to the LORD, He heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Now look, we are in Kadesh, a city on the edge of your territory.

speaker: israelite-messengers
text: Please let us pass through your land. We will not cut through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway; we will not turn to the right or to the left until we have passed through your territory.

speaker: edom
name: Edom
text: You may not travel through our land, or we will come out and confront you with the sword.

speaker: israelites
text: We will stay on the main road,

speaker: israelites
text: and if we or our herds drink your water, we will pay for it. There will be no problem; only let us pass through on foot.

speaker: edom
text: You may not pass through.

speaker: god
text: Aaron will be gathered to his people; he will not enter the land that I have given the Israelites, because both of you rebelled against My command at the waters of Meribah.

speaker: god
text: Take Aaron and his son Eleazar and bring them up Mount Hor.

speaker: god
text: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there.

speaker: israelites
name: Israel
text: If You will deliver this people into our hands, we will devote their cities to destruction.

speaker: israelites
text: Why have you led us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? There is no bread or water, and we detest this wretched food!

speaker: israelites
text: We have sinned by speaking against the LORD and against you. Intercede with the LORD so He will take the snakes away from us.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Make a fiery serpent and mount it on a pole. When anyone who is bitten looks at it, he will live.

text: Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of the Arnon,

speaker: israelites
text: The princes dug the well; the nobles of the people hollowed it out with their scepters and with their staffs.

text: Let us pass through your land. We will not cut through any field or vineyard, or drink water from any well. We will stay on the King’s Highway until we have passed through your territory.

speaker: poets
name: The poets
text: Come to Heshbon, let it be rebuilt; let the city of Sihon be restored.

speaker: poets
text: For a fire went out from Heshbon, a blaze from the city of Sihon. It consumed Ar of Moab, the rulers of Arnon’s heights.

speaker: poets
text: Woe to you, O Moab! You are destroyed, O people of Chemosh! He gave up his sons as refugees, and his daughters into captivity to Sihon king of the Amorites.

speaker: poets
text: But we have overthrown them; Heshbon is destroyed as far as Dibon. We demolished them as far as Nophah, which reaches to Medeba.

speaker: god
text: Do not fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, along with all his people and his land. Do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.

speaker: moabites
name: The Moabites
text: This horde will devour everything around us, as an ox licks up the grass of the field.

speaker: balak
name: Balak
text: Behold, a people has come out of Egypt,

speaker: balak
text: They cover the face of the land and have settled next to me.

speaker: balak
text: So please come now and put a curse on this people, because they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I may be able to defeat them and drive them out of the land; for I know that those you bless are blessed, and those you curse are cursed.

speaker: balaam
name: Balaam
text: Spend the night here,

speaker: balaam
text: and I will give you the answer that the LORD speaks to me.

speaker: god
name: God
text: Who are these men with you?

speaker: balaam
text: Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent me this message:

speaker: balaam
text: ‘Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away.’

speaker: balak
text: Behold, a people has come out of Egypt, and they cover the face of the land. Now come and put a curse on them for me. Perhaps I may be able to fight against them and drive them away.

speaker: god
text: Do not go with them. You are not to curse this people, for they are blessed.

speaker: balaam
text: Go back to your homeland, because the LORD has refused to let me go with you.

speaker: princes-of-moab
name: The princes of Moab
text: Balaam refused to come with us.

speaker: princes-of-moab
text: This is what Balak son of Zippor says: ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

speaker: balak
text: Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

speaker: princes-of-moab
text: for I will honor you richly and do whatever you say. So please come and put a curse on this people for me!’

speaker: balak
text: for I will honor you richly and do whatever you say. So please come and put a curse on this people for me!

speaker: balaam
text: If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything small or great to go beyond the command of the LORD my God.

speaker: balaam
text: So now, please stay here overnight as the others did, that I may find out what else the LORD has to tell me.

speaker: god
text: Since these men have come to summon you, get up and go with them, but you must only do what I tell you.

speaker: balaams-donkey
name: Balaam's donkey
text: What have I done to you that you have beaten me these three times?

speaker: balaam
text: You have made a fool of me! If I had a sword in my hand, I would kill you right now!

speaker: balaams-donkey
text: Am I not the donkey you have ridden all your life until today? Have I ever treated you this way before?

speaker: balaam
text: No,

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
name: The angel of the LORD
text: Why have you beaten your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out to oppose you, because your way is perverse before me.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: The donkey saw me and turned away from me these three times. If she had not turned away, then by now I would surely have killed you and let her live.

speaker: balaam
text: I have sinned,

speaker: balaam
text: for I did not realize that you were standing in the road to confront me. And now, if this is displeasing in your sight, I will go back home.

speaker: angel-of-the-lord
text: Go with the men, but you are to speak only what I tell you.

speaker: balak
text: Did I not send you an urgent summons? Why did you not come to me? Am I really not able to richly reward you?

speaker: balaam
text: See, I have come to you,

speaker: balaam
text: but can I say just anything? I must speak only the word that God puts in my mouth.

speaker: balaam
name: Balaam
text: Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.

speaker: balaam
text: Stay here by your burnt offering while I am gone,

speaker: balaam
text: Perhaps the LORD will meet with me. And whatever He reveals to me, I will tell you.

speaker: balaam
text: I have set up seven altars,

speaker: balaam
text: and on each altar I have offered a bull and a ram.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Return to Balak and give him this message.

speaker: balaam
text: Balak brought me from Aram, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east. ‘Come,’ he said, ‘put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!’

speaker: balak
name: Balak
text: Come,

speaker: balak
text: put a curse on Jacob for me; come and denounce Israel!

speaker: balaam
text: How can I curse what God has not cursed? How can I denounce what the LORD has not denounced?

speaker: balaam
text: For I see them from atop the rocky cliffs, and I watch them from the hills. Behold, a people dwelling apart, not reckoning themselves among the nations.

speaker: balaam
text: Who can count the dust of Jacob or number even a fourth of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous; let my end be like theirs!

speaker: balak
text: What have you done to me? I brought you here to curse my enemies, and behold, you have only blessed them!

speaker: balaam
text: Should I not speak exactly what the LORD puts in my mouth?

speaker: balak
text: Please come with me to another place where you can see them. You will only see the outskirts of their camp—not all of them. And from there, curse them for me.

speaker: balaam
text: Stay here beside your burnt offering while I meet the LORD over there.

speaker: god
text: Return to Balak and speak what I tell you.

speaker: balak
text: What did the LORD say?

speaker: balaam
text: Arise, O Balak, and listen; give ear to me, O son of Zippor.

speaker: balaam
text: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?

speaker: balaam
text: I have indeed received a command to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot change it.

speaker: balaam
text: He considers no disaster for Jacob; He sees no trouble for Israel. The LORD their God is with them, and the shout of the King is among them.

speaker: balaam
text: God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.

speaker: balaam
text: For there is no spell against Jacob and no divination against Israel. It will now be said of Jacob and Israel, ‘What great things God has done!’

speaker: unnamed-people
name: Unnamed speakers
text: What great things God has done!

speaker: balaam
text: Behold, the people rise like a lioness; they rouse themselves like a lion, not resting until they devour their prey and drink the blood of the slain.

speaker: balak
text: Then neither curse them at all nor bless them at all!

speaker: balaam
text: Did I not tell you that whatever the LORD says, I must do?

speaker: balak
text: Please come,

speaker: balak
text: I will take you to another place. Perhaps it will please God that you curse them for me from there.

speaker: balaam
text: Build for me seven altars here, and prepare for me seven bulls and seven rams.

speaker: balaam
name: Balaam
text: This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,

speaker: balaam
text: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:

speaker: balaam
text: How lovely are your tents, O Jacob, your dwellings, O Israel!

speaker: balaam
text: They spread out like palm groves, like gardens beside a stream, like aloes the LORD has planted, like cedars beside the waters.

speaker: balaam
text: Water will flow from his buckets, and his seed will have abundant water. His king will be greater than Agag, and his kingdom will be exalted.

speaker: balaam
text: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox, to devour hostile nations and crush their bones, to pierce them with arrows.

speaker: balaam
text: He crouches, he lies down like a lion; like a lioness, who dares to rouse him? Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you.

speaker: balak
name: Balak
text: I summoned you to curse my enemies, but behold, you have persisted in blessing them these three times.

speaker: balak
text: Therefore, flee at once to your home! I said I would richly reward you, but instead the LORD has denied your reward.

speaker: balaam
text: Did I not already tell the messengers you sent me

speaker: balaam
text: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not do anything of my own accord, good or bad, to go beyond the command of the LORD? I will speak whatever the LORD says.

speaker: balaam
text: Now I am going back to my people, but come, let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come.

speaker: balaam
text: This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor, the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open,

speaker: balaam
text: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God, who has knowledge from the Most High, who sees a vision from the Almighty, who bows down with eyes wide open:

speaker: balaam
text: I see him, but not now; I behold him, but not near. A star will come forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel. He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth.

speaker: balaam
text: Edom will become a possession, as will Seir, his enemy; but Israel will perform with valor.

speaker: balaam
text: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city.

speaker: balaam
text: Amalek was first among the nations, but his end is destruction.

speaker: balaam
text: Your dwelling place is secure, and your nest is set in a cliff.

speaker: balaam
text: Yet Kain will be destroyed when Asshur takes you captive.

speaker: balaam
text: Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?

speaker: balaam
text: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus; they will subdue Asshur and Eber, but they too will perish forever.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.

speaker: god
text: Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the Israelites; for he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not consume the Israelites in My zeal.

speaker: god
text: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.

speaker: god
text: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.

speaker: god
text: Attack the Midianites and strike them dead.

speaker: god
text: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of the Midianite leader, the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by the houses of their fathers—all those twenty years of age or older who can serve in the army of Israel.

speaker: moses-and-eleazar
name: Moses and Eleazar
text: Take a census of the men twenty years of age or older, as the LORD has commanded Moses.

speaker: god
text: The land is to be divided among the tribes as an inheritance, according to the number of names.

speaker: god
text: Increase the inheritance for a large tribe and decrease it for a small one; each tribe is to receive its inheritance according to the number of those registered.

speaker: god
text: Indeed, the land must be divided by lot; they shall receive their inheritance according to the names of the tribes of their fathers.

speaker: god
text: Each inheritance is to be divided by lot among the larger and smaller tribes.

name: The daughters of Zelophehad (Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah)
text: Our father died in the wilderness, but he was not among the followers of Korah who gathered together against the LORD. Instead, he died because of his own sin, and he had no sons.

speaker: daughters-of-zelophehad
text: Why should the name of our father disappear from his clan because he had no sons? Give us property among our father’s brothers.

name: The LORD
text: The daughters of Zelophehad speak correctly. You certainly must give them property as an inheritance among their father’s brothers, and transfer their father’s inheritance to them.
