text: Furthermore, you shall say to the Israelites, ‘If a man dies and leaves no son, you are to transfer his inheritance to his daughter.

text: Go up this mountain of the Abarim range and see the land that I have given the Israelites.

text: After you have seen it, you too will be gathered to your people, as your brother Aaron was;

text: for when the congregation contended in the Wilderness of Zin, both of you rebelled against My command to show My holiness in their sight regarding the waters.

text: Take Joshua son of Nun, a man with the Spirit in him, and lay your hands on him.

text: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.

speaker: god
text: Confer on him some of your authority, so that the whole congregation of Israel will obey him.

speaker: god
text: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who will seek counsel for him before the LORD by the judgment of the Urim. At his command, he and all the Israelites with him—the entire congregation—will go out and come in.

name: The LORD
text: Command the Israelites and say to them: See that you present to Me at its appointed time the food for My offerings by fire, as a pleasing aroma to Me.

speaker: god
text: And tell them that this is the offering made by fire you are to present to the LORD as a regular burnt offering each day: two unblemished year-old male lambs.

text: The drink offering accompanying each lamb shall be a quarter hin. Pour out the offering of fermented drink to the LORD in the sanctuary area.

text: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of thirteen young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil with each of the thirteen bulls, two-tenths of an ephah with each of the two rams,

speaker: god
text: and a tenth of an ephah with each of the fourteen lambs.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the second day you are to present twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the third day you are to present eleven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the fourth day you are to present ten bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the fifth day you are to present nine bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the sixth day you are to present eight bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the seventh day you are to present seven bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: On the eighth day you are to hold a solemn assembly; you must not do any regular work.

speaker: god
text: As a pleasing aroma to the LORD, you are to present an offering made by fire, a burnt offering of one bull, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, all unblemished,

speaker: god
text: along with the grain and drink offerings for the bulls, rams, and lambs, according to the number prescribed.

speaker: god
text: Include one male goat as a sin offering, in addition to the regular burnt offering with its grain offering and drink offering.

speaker: god
text: You are to present these offerings to the LORD at your appointed times, in addition to your vow and freewill offerings, whether burnt offerings, grain offerings, drink offerings, or peace offerings.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: This is what the LORD has commanded:

speaker: moses
text: If a man makes a vow to the LORD or swears an oath to obligate himself by a pledge, he must not break his word; he must do everything he has promised.

speaker: moses
text: And if a woman in her father’s house during her youth makes a vow to the LORD or obligates herself by a pledge,

speaker: moses
text: and her father hears about her vow or pledge but says nothing to her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.

speaker: moses
text: But if her father prohibits her on the day he hears about it, then none of the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand. The LORD will absolve her because her father has prohibited her.

speaker: moses
text: If a woman marries while under a vow or rash promise by which she has bound herself,

speaker: moses
text: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her on that day, then the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.

speaker: moses
text: But if her husband prohibits her when he hears of it, he nullifies the vow that binds her or the rash promise she has made, and the LORD will absolve her.

speaker: moses
text: Every vow a widow or divorced woman pledges to fulfill is binding on her.

speaker: moses
text: If a woman in her husband’s house has made a vow or put herself under an obligation with an oath,

speaker: moses
text: and her husband hears of it but says nothing to her and does not prohibit her, then all the vows or pledges by which she has bound herself shall stand.

speaker: moses
text: But if her husband nullifies them on the day he hears of them, then nothing that came from her lips, whether her vows or pledges, shall stand. Her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will absolve her.

speaker: moses
text: Her husband may confirm or nullify any vow or any sworn pledge to deny herself.

speaker: moses
text: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he confirms all the vows and pledges that bind her. He has confirmed them, because he said nothing to her on the day he heard about them.

speaker: moses
text: But if he nullifies them after he hears of them, then he will bear her iniquity.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Take vengeance on the Midianites for the Israelites. After that, you will be gathered to your people.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Arm some of your men for war, that they may go against the Midianites and execute the LORD’s vengeance on them.

speaker: moses
text: Send into battle a thousand men from each tribe of Israel.

speaker: moses
text: Have you spared all the women?

speaker: moses
text: Look, these women caused the sons of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to turn unfaithfully against the LORD at Peor, so that the plague struck the congregation of the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: So now, kill all the boys, as well as every woman who has had relations with a man,

speaker: moses
text: but spare for yourselves every girl who has never had relations with a man.

speaker: moses
text: All of you who have killed a person or touched the dead are to remain outside the camp for seven days. On the third day and the seventh day you are to purify both yourselves and your captives.

speaker: moses
text: And purify every garment and leather good, everything made of goat’s hair, and every article of wood.

speaker: eleazar
name: Eleazar
text: This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses:

speaker: eleazar
text: Only the gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, and lead—

speaker: eleazar
text: everything that can withstand the fire—must be put through the fire, and it will be clean. But it must still be purified with the water of purification. And everything that cannot withstand the fire must pass through the water.

speaker: eleazar
text: On the seventh day you are to wash your clothes, and you will be clean. After that you may enter the camp.

speaker: god
text: You and Eleazar the priest and the family heads of the congregation are to take a count of what was captured, both of man and beast.

speaker: god
text: Then divide the captives between the troops who went out to battle and the rest of the congregation.

speaker: god
text: Set aside a tribute for the LORD from what belongs to the soldiers who went into battle: one out of every five hundred, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, or sheep.

speaker: god
text: Take it from their half and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to the LORD.

speaker: god
text: From the Israelites’ half, take one out of every fifty, whether persons, cattle, donkeys, sheep, or other animals, and give them to the Levites who keep charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.

speaker: officers-of-the-army
name: The officers of the army
text: Your servants have counted the soldiers under our command, and not one of us is missing.

speaker: officers-of-the-army
text: So we have brought to the LORD an offering of the gold articles each man acquired—armlets, bracelets, rings, earrings, and necklaces—to make atonement for ourselves before the LORD.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
name: The Gadites and Reubenites
text: Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: which the LORD conquered before the congregation of Israel, are suitable for livestock—and your servants have livestock.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: If we have found favor in your sight,

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: let this land be given to your servants as a possession. Do not make us cross the Jordan.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

speaker: moses
text: Why are you discouraging the Israelites from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?

speaker: moses
text: This is what your fathers did when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to inspect the land.

speaker: moses
text: For when your fathers went up to the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, they discouraged the Israelites from entering the land that the LORD had given them.

speaker: moses
text: So the anger of the LORD was kindled that day, and He swore an oath, saying,

speaker: moses
text: ‘Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly, not one of the men twenty years of age or older who came out of Egypt will see the land that I swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—

speaker: moses
text: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.’

speaker: god
text: not one except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun—because they did follow the LORD wholeheartedly.

speaker: moses
text: The anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until the whole generation who had done evil in His sight was gone.

speaker: moses
text: Now behold, you, a brood of sinners, have risen up in place of your fathers to further stoke the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.

speaker: moses
text: For if you turn away from following Him, He will once again leave this people in the wilderness, and you will be the cause of their destruction.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: We want to build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: But we will arm ourselves and be ready to go ahead of the Israelites until we have brought them into their place. Meanwhile, our little ones will remain in the fortified cities for protection from the inhabitants of the land.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: Yet we will not have an inheritance with them across the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on the east side of the Jordan.

speaker: moses
text: If you will do this—if you will arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,

speaker: moses
text: and if every one of your armed men crosses the Jordan before the LORD, until He has driven His enemies out before Him,

speaker: moses
text: then when the land is subdued before the LORD, you may return and be free of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. And this land will belong to you as a possession before the LORD.

speaker: moses
text: But if you do not do this, you will certainly sin against the LORD—and be assured that your sin will find you out.

speaker: moses
text: Build cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, but do what you have promised.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: Your servants will do just as our lord commands.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: Our children, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will remain here in the cities of Gilead.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: But your servants are equipped for war, and every man will cross over to the battle before the LORD, just as our lord says.

speaker: moses
text: If the Gadites and Reubenites cross the Jordan with you, with every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you are to give them the land of Gilead as a possession.

speaker: moses
text: But if they do not arm themselves and go across with you, then they must accept their possession among you in the land of Canaan.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: As the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.

speaker: gadites-and-reubenites
text: We will cross over into the land of Canaan armed before the LORD, that we may have our inheritance on this side of the Jordan.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

speaker: god
text: you must drive out before you all the inhabitants of the land, destroy all their carved images and cast idols, and demolish all their high places.

speaker: god
text: You are to take possession of the land and settle in it, for I have given you the land to possess.

speaker: god
text: And you are to divide the land by lot according to your clans. Give a larger inheritance to a larger clan and a smaller inheritance to a smaller one. Whatever falls to each one by lot will be his. You will receive an inheritance according to the tribes of your fathers.

speaker: god
text: But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land before you, those you allow to remain will become barbs in your eyes and thorns in your sides; they will harass you in the land where you settle.

speaker: god
text: And then I will do to you what I had planned to do to them.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Command the Israelites and say to them: When you enter the land of Canaan, it will be allotted to you as an inheritance with these boundaries:

speaker: god
text: Your southern border will extend from the Wilderness of Zin along the border of Edom. On the east, your southern border will run from the end of the Salt Sea,

speaker: god
text: cross south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, continue to Zin, and go south of Kadesh-barnea. Then it will go on to Hazar-addar and proceed to Azmon,

speaker: god
text: where it will turn from Azmon, join the Brook of Egypt, and end at the Sea.

speaker: god
text: Your western border will be the coastline of the Great Sea; this will be your boundary on the west.

speaker: god
text: Your northern border will run from the Great Sea directly to Mount Hor,

speaker: god
text: and from Mount Hor to Lebo-hamath, then extend to Zedad,

speaker: god
text: continue to Ziphron, and end at Hazar-enan. This will be your boundary on the north.

speaker: god
text: And your eastern border will run straight from Hazar-enan to Shepham,

speaker: god
text: then go down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain and continue along the slopes east of the Sea of Chinnereth.

speaker: god
text: Then the border will go down along the Jordan and end at the Salt Sea. This will be your land, defined by its borders on all sides.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: Apportion this land by lot as an inheritance. The LORD has commanded that it be given to the nine and a half tribes.

speaker: moses
text: For the tribes of the Reubenites and Gadites, along with the half-tribe of Manasseh, have already received their inheritance.

speaker: moses
text: These two and a half tribes have received their inheritance across the Jordan from Jericho, toward the sunrise.

speaker: god
text: These are the names of the men who are to assign the land as an inheritance for you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun.

speaker: god
text: Appoint one leader from each tribe to distribute the land.

speaker: god
text: These are their names: Caleb son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah;

speaker: god
text: Shemuel son of Ammihud from the tribe of Simeon;

speaker: god
text: Elidad son of Chislon from the tribe of Benjamin;

speaker: god
text: Bukki son of Jogli, a leader from the tribe of Dan;

speaker: god
text: Hanniel son of Ephod, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph;

speaker: god
text: Kemuel son of Shiphtan, a leader from the tribe of Ephraim;

speaker: god
text: Eli-zaphan son of Parnach, a leader from the tribe of Zebulun;

speaker: god
text: Paltiel son of Azzan, a leader from the tribe of Issachar;

speaker: god
text: Ahihud son of Shelomi, a leader from the tribe of Asher;

speaker: god
text: and Pedahel son of Ammihud, a leader from the tribe of Naphtali.

speaker: god
name: The LORD
text: Command the Israelites to give, from the inheritance they will possess, cities for the Levites to live in and pasturelands around the cities.

speaker: god
text: The cities will be for them to live in, and the pasturelands will be for their herds, their flocks, and all their other livestock.

speaker: god
text: The pasturelands around the cities you are to give the Levites will extend a thousand cubits from the wall on every side.

speaker: god
text: You are also to measure two thousand cubits outside the city on the east, two thousand on the south, two thousand on the west, and two thousand on the north, with the city in the center. These areas will serve as larger pasturelands for the cities.

speaker: god
text: Six of the cities you give the Levites are to be appointed as cities of refuge, to which a manslayer may flee. In addition to these, give the Levites forty-two other cities.

speaker: god
text: The total number of cities you give the Levites will be forty-eight, with their corresponding pasturelands.

speaker: god
text: The cities that you apportion from the territory of the Israelites should be given to the Levites in proportion to the inheritance of each tribe: more from a larger tribe and less from a smaller one.

speaker: god
text: Speak to the Israelites and tell them: When you cross the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

speaker: god
text: designate cities to serve as your cities of refuge, so that a person who kills someone unintentionally may flee there.

speaker: god
text: You are to have these cities as a refuge from the avenger, so that the manslayer will not die until he stands trial before the assembly.

speaker: god
text: The cities you select will be your six cities of refuge.

speaker: god
text: Select three cities across the Jordan and three in the land of Canaan as cities of refuge.

speaker: god
text: These six cities will serve as a refuge for the Israelites and for the foreigner or stranger among them, so that anyone who kills a person unintentionally may flee there.

speaker: god
text: If, however, anyone strikes a person with an iron object and kills him, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

speaker: god
text: Or if anyone has in his hand a stone of deadly size, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

speaker: god
text: If anyone has in his hand a deadly object of wood, and he strikes and kills another, he is a murderer; the murderer must surely be put to death.

speaker: god
text: The avenger of blood is to put the murderer to death; when he finds him, he is to kill him.

speaker: god
text: Likewise, if anyone maliciously pushes another or intentionally throws an object at him and kills him,

speaker: god
text: or if in hostility he strikes him with his hand and he dies, the one who struck him must surely be put to death; he is a murderer. When the avenger of blood finds the murderer, he is to kill him.

speaker: god
text: But if anyone pushes a person suddenly, without hostility, or throws an object at him unintentionally,

speaker: god
text: or without looking drops a heavy stone that kills him, but he was not an enemy and did not intend to harm him,

speaker: god
text: then the congregation must judge between the slayer and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

speaker: god
text: The assembly is to protect the manslayer from the hand of the avenger of blood. Then the assembly will return him to the city of refuge to which he fled, and he must live there until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

speaker: god
text: But if the manslayer ever goes outside the limits of the city of refuge to which he fled

speaker: god
text: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of his city of refuge and kills him, then the avenger will not be guilty of bloodshed

speaker: god
text: because the manslayer must remain in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. Only after the death of the high priest may he return to the land he owns.

speaker: god
text: This will be a statutory ordinance for you for the generations to come, wherever you live.

speaker: god
text: If anyone kills a person, the murderer is to be put to death on the testimony of the witnesses. But no one is to be put to death based on the testimony of a lone witness.

speaker: god
text: You are not to accept a ransom for the life of a murderer who deserves to die; he must surely be put to death.

speaker: god
text: Nor should you accept a ransom for the person who flees to a city of refuge and allow him to return and live on his own land before the death of the high priest.

speaker: god
text: Do not pollute the land where you live, for bloodshed pollutes the land, and no atonement can be made for the land on which the blood is shed, except by the blood of the one who shed it.

speaker: god
text: Do not defile the land where you live and where I dwell. For I, the LORD, dwell among the Israelites.

speaker: family-heads-of-gilead
name: The family heads of the clan of Gilead
text: When the LORD commanded my lord to give the land as an inheritance to the Israelites by lot, He also commanded him to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.

speaker: family-heads-of-gilead
text: But if they marry any of the men from the other tribes of Israel, their inheritance will be withdrawn from the portion of our fathers and added to the tribe into which they marry. So our allotted inheritance would be taken away.

speaker: family-heads-of-gilead
text: And when the Jubilee for the Israelites comes, their inheritance will be added to the tribe into which they marry and taken away from the tribe of our fathers.

speaker: moses
name: Moses
text: The tribe of the sons of Joseph speaks correctly.

speaker: moses
text: This is what the LORD has commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad: They may marry anyone they please, provided they marry within a clan of the tribe of their father.

speaker: moses
text: No inheritance in Israel may be transferred from tribe to tribe, because each of the Israelites is to retain the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

speaker: moses
text: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance from any Israelite tribe must marry within a clan of the tribe of her father, so that every Israelite will possess the inheritance of his fathers.

speaker: moses
text: No inheritance may be transferred from one tribe to another, for each tribe of Israel must retain its inheritance.
